register.labelZh: TIE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tie somebody down 可表示令某人就答案、日期或安排作出明確承諾。；tie in with 可用來比較說法、日期、數字、訊息和事實是否一致。；tie in with 和 tie something in with something 可表示書籍、課堂、廣告和活動如何互相配合。；TIE 片語動詞可用來描述把繩端扎好、把船繫在碼頭、在表演中安全地綁好表演者,以及把包裹捆好。
register.summaryEn: Tie somebody down helps you talk about getting a firm answer, date or agreement from someone. Tie in with helps you compare stories, dates, numbers, messages and facts. Tie in with and tie something in with something show how books, lessons, adverts and events are planned to support one another. The TIE family can describe closing a rope end, mooring a boat, tying a performer safely during a show or fastening a parcel.
contextsZh: 表達活動和產品之間的配合
描述不同的綁緊和固定方式
contextsEn: Describe different ways of securing things
